# A test picks a select a block built at run time holds -- a reactive `if`'s
# branch, a tab's panel -- by the value it holds, on every target. gtk4 wraps
# a select per call site, its effects being state, and builds the wrapper
# there as an instance whose method the select's trigger is, which a test had
# no route to: the trigger was restored to the event, whose invoker takes a
# label, so the int choice did not compile.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

enum Fruit { apple, banana, cherry }

component branch ui.node {
    var on = true
    var pick = Fruit.apple

    ui.vbox {
        if on {
            ui.select #fruit(:value=pick) {
                ui.choice(label="Apple", value=Fruit.apple)
                ui.choice(label="Banana", value=Fruit.banana)
                ui.choice(label="Cherry", value=Fruit.cherry)
            }
        }
    }
}

// A typed select a reactive `if` holds is picked by the value it holds.
func testATypedSelectUnderAnIf(t test.Test, c branch) {
    if c.fruit != null {
        c.fruit.change(Fruit.banana)
    }
    t.assert(c.pick == Fruit.banana)
}

component panel ui.node {
    var at = 1
    var pick = 1

    ui.tabs(:selected=at) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text("first")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Two") {
            ui.select #size(:value=pick) {
                ui.choice(label="Small", value=1)
                ui.choice(label="Large", value=2)
            }
        }
    }
}

// A typed select in a tab's panel is picked by the value it holds.
func testATypedSelectInATab(t test.Test, c panel) {
    if c.size != null {
        c.size.change(2)
    }
    t.assert(c.pick == 2)
}

ui.window {
    branch()
}
